Patch Set 15:

(3 comments)
Set Work In Progress
Please try to avoid adding build configuration options. Any new build configuration options need to come with significant justification as to why the behaviour can't compose well at runtime.
The commit message is to describe "why", not "what". "What" is documented in the patch itself. Please remove this.
Done
This heading is unnecessary. Further, describing the motivation is what the commit message is for, making this also unnecessary.
Done
Why is this true? Why does this need to be true?
It's not clear to me how a 1-second retry properly addresses this concern. It may reduce the probability that many messages are missed, but it doesn't eliminate the concern that no messages are lost.

This sounds like it interacts badly with the console mux behaviour. Can you please work discuss how your requirements can compose with that feature?

In-tree documentation: https://github.com/openbmc/obmc-console/blob/master/docs/mux-support.md
Design documentation: https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/uart-mux-support.md
Hi Sean, this one needs a bit of work. I have some comments inline.
Hi Andrew, thanks for the feedback. I'll need some time to address these comments, so I'm marking this as a work in progress.
This means that, by default, it will not be built during CI, which I can't accept.
